questions.q: What does Luka ask about first?
questions.e: In the video: "Da li vam baterija na telefonu traje tri dana" — does your phone battery last three days?

questions.q: How long has the woman worked in the kitchen?
questions.e: In the video: "Četvrta godina" — the fourth year.
In the video: "spremili smo vam nov telefon, Redmi Note 17" — we have prepared a new phone for you, the Redmi Note 17.

questions.q: What is the new phone resistant to?
questions.e: In the video: "otporan je i na udarce i na prašinu" — it is resistant to both knocks and dust.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Da li vam *baterija* na telefonu traje tri dana?
Pohvalili su vas da ste *vredni*, da ste radni

questions.e: The preposition u answering "where?" takes the locative: u kuhinji.

questions.q: Njemu baterija traje čak do tri ___
questions.e: After the numerals 2–4 comes the genitive singular: tri dana.
The verb nadati se ("to hope, expect") takes the dative: telefonu.

questions.q: Imate li par minuta da ___ malo ukradem?
questions.e: To steal whom? — the accusative: vas.
